description: This file defines the Teradata_MCP class implementing an MCP tool node, including methods for initializing, listing actions, and retrieving tools with credential handling and caching.

classes.name: Teradata_MCP
classes.description: A class representing a Teradata MCP tool node with methods for initialization, listing actions, and fetching tools with credential management.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains the listActions method to asynchronously list available actions from the MCP server.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node by filtering tools based on selected MCP actions.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Fetches tools from the MCP server, handling credentials, caching, and setting up the MCPToolkit.
